question: What spatial exclusion is required before constructing the very great abode?
premises: A measure of nine daṇḍas is specified.
This measure must be excluded beforehand.
After exclusion, construction of the abode is prescribed.
inference: The very great abode should be constructed only after setting aside a distance of nine daṇḍas.
uncertainties: The exact physical length of a daṇḍa in this context is not specified in the verse.
The precise reference point from which the nine daṇḍas are measured is not stated.
plain_english: After excluding nine daṇḍas, one should indeed construct the very great abode.
